verdict.rationale: Entra ID's own docs describe SCIM-based automatic provisioning of users and groups into SaaS apps such as Dropbox, Salesforce and ServiceNow, plus on-premises apps and a gallery of SCIM-enabled apps. The pack does not show entitlements (roles or app permissions) being pushed, or provisioning being triggered the moment access is assigned. Missing for 10: documented push of entitlements/roles to downstream apps, evidence that provisioning is triggered by assignment and how fast it runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, accounts create themselves — SCIM provisioning pushes users, groups, and entitlements into downstream apps the moment access is assigned

citations.quote: you can use the System for Cross-Domain Identity Management (SCIM) user management API to enable automatic provisioning of users and groups between your application and Microsoft Entra ID
Common scenarios include provisioning a Microsoft Entra user into SaaS applications like Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and many more.
Microsoft Entra ID also supports provisioning users into applications hosted on-premises or in a virtual machine, without having to open up any firewalls.
use the application network portal to request a SCIM enabled application to be added to the gallery for automatic provisioning
